caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, pattern equal to form, closed color shapes, tapestry space, courtiers of the shah standing in rows before a throne, one holding a falcon, robes of lapis and cinnabar with gold sashes, a flowering tree and a patterned carpet on a pale ground, lapis blue, cinnabar red, malachite green, gold, jade white
notes_zh: 《阿拔斯一世宫廷群像》(Walters W691A, Commons PD, Safavid 17世纪)：廷臣列+持鹰者+花树与地毯。
